description.value: Don Mee Seafood Restaurant is a landmark Cantonese and seafood institution that has anchored Victoria's Historic Chinatown for over 80 years. The restaurant serves daily dim sum from trolleys alongside a full dinner menu of Cantonese, Szechuan, and Western-style dishes, and can host banquets for up to 260 guests. Located a short walk from the Inner Harbour, the Empress Hotel, and the Royal BC Museum, it is a well-known destination for both locals and visitors.
